card.text: Red dwarf 1.30 parsecs away, the nearest star to the Sun; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Proxima Centauri is a red dwarf 1.30 parsecs away, the closest known star to the Sun, about one seventh of its radius. Here its surface is a plain sphere.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of Hubble's calibrated spectrum of the star. No surface picture or edge darkening is measured.
